benefits.text: A concealer with densely concentrated covering pigments that provides perfect coverage, creating smooth, flawless skin. The ultra-natural coverage formula helps perfectly cover skin imperfections with just a small amount.

howToUse.text: Use to cover imperfections on the skin, then apply foundation, powder,...

safety.text:
For external use only; do not use on damaged skin
Discontinue use if signs of irritation appear, and keep out of reach of children.

positioning.text: Long-lasting concealer that gives natural coverage with just a small amount to complete a smooth base.

sellingPoints.text: Dense covering pigments; natural coverage with a small amount; long-lasting, long-wearing color.

claimDisclaimers.text: “Flawless” should be interpreted as a makeup effect; do not say it absolutely covers every imperfection.
Do not say “perfect” in the sense of completely covering every dark spot/blemish.
Do not claim no oxidation/no darkening unless the source states it.
Do not say it replaces treatment for acne/dark spots.
